jobs.title: Research Specialist (Data Science and Artificial Intelligence)
jobs.description:
This is a Fully Remote Job

About Our Client:

The organization operates within the academic research sector, focusing on advancing science through laboratory investigation. It addresses challenges in experimental research by supporting specialized scientific studies and fostering development of new research techniques. The program serves as a hub for laboratory-based research efforts, contributing to scientific publications and innovation in its field.

About the Opportunity:

The RESEARCH SPECIALIST is responsible for conducting a variety of laboratory assays and experiments aligned with specific research areas. This role supports the research team by executing experiments, troubleshooting, and aiding in training new laboratory personnel. It ensures the accuracy and reliability of experimental processes and contributes to the development of research methodologies, directly impacting the quality and progression of scientific studies.

Responsibilities:

Plan and conduct experiments in collaboration with investigators, adapting protocols as needed within established parameters.
Interpret experimental results using specialized scientific knowledge.
Evaluate the functionality of experiment components based on lab experience.
Train and orient new staff and learners in laboratory procedures.
Assist in developing new research techniques and instruments.
Review published research methods relevant to current experiments.
Prepare analyzed data for scientific publications.
Manage ordering of equipment and supplies and liaise with vendors.
Support problem-solving for junior lab members regarding research assays.
Contribute to protocol development to improve efficiency and productivity.
Participate in writing methodology sections for manuscripts and grant applications.
Perform other assigned duties.

Requirements:

Bachelor’s degree in Biology, Chemistry, or a related field.
Minimum of one year laboratory experience performing relevant techniques.
Additional education may substitute for experience, and vice versa, according to the employer’s equivalency formula.

Pay Range and Compensation Package:

Starting salary range: $18.71 to $32.69 per hour, commensurate with experience.

Benefits & Perks:

This role is classified as casual/on call with a Monday to Friday schedule.
Location is remote.

Equal Opportunity Statement:
Our client is an equal opportunity employer. They celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or national origin.

Note:

TalentHop is a recruitment partner of this role. Please note that all employment decisions, including candidate assessment, interviews, hiring, compensation, and employment terms, are made exclusively by the hiring employer.
